wikipedia.extract: Sternula is a genus of small white terns, with a global distribution along sheltered sandy coasts and large rivers.
wikipedia.title: Sternula

commonNames.name: Black-handed Tamarin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black tamarin (Saguinus niger) or western black-handed tamarin is a species of tamarin endemic to Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Black tamarin

wikipedia.extract: Daubentonia is the sole genus of the Daubentoniidae, a family of lemuroid primate native to much of Madagascar. The aye-aye (Daubentonia madagascariensis) is the only extant member.
wikipedia.title: Daubentonia

wikipedia.extract: The barbthroats are a genus Threnetes of South American hummingbirds in the family Trochilidae.
wikipedia.title: Barbthroat

wikipedia.extract: The agami heron (Agamia agami) is a medium-sized heron. It is a resident breeding bird from Central America south to Peru and Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Agami heron

wikipedia.extract: Archaeolemur is an extinct genus of subfossil lemurs known from the Quaternary of Madagascar. Archaeolemur is one of the most common and well-known of the extinct giant lemurs as hundreds of its bones have been discovered in fossil deposits across the island.
wikipedia.title: Archaeolemur

wikipedia.extract: Chaetura is a genus of needletail swifts found in the Americas. Although they resemble swallows, the two are not at all closely related; this is instead a result of convergent evolution.
wikipedia.title: Chaetura

wikipedia.extract: The mantled guereza (Colobus guereza), also known simply as the guereza, historically the eastern black-and-white colobus, and Abyssinian black-and-white colobus, is a black-and-white colobus, a type of Old World monkey. It is native to much of west central and east Africa, including Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and Chad.
wikipedia.title: Mantled guereza

commonNames.name: Bearded Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-striped capuchin (Sapajus libidinosus), also known as the bearded capuchin, is a New World monkey in the family Cebidae. They are native to northern and central Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Black-striped capuchin

commonNames.name: Buller's Albatross
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Buller's albatross (Thalassarche bulleri) or Buller's mollymawk is a small mollymawk in the albatross family. It breeds on islands around New Zealand, and feeds in the seas off Australia and the South Pacific.
wikipedia.title: Buller's albatross

wikipedia.extract: The Accipitriformes (; from Latin accipiter 'hawk' and formes 'having the form of') are an order of birds that includes most of the diurnal birds of prey, including hawks, eagles, vultures, kites, ospreys and secretary birds, but not falcons or seriemas. The generally nocturnal owls, also considered birds of prey, are a separate order from the accipitriformes.
wikipedia.title: Accipitriformes

commonNames.name: Burnished Saki
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The burnished saki (Pithecia inusta) is a species of saki monkey, a type of New World monkey. It is found in central Peru and a small portion of adjacent Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Burnished saki
